source.section: Schedule 2 line 11 code 632 and PDF page 22 Military Retirement Income and/or Survivor's Benefits Deduction; settlement conflict: the web page's age 60 test ('Updated for 2023') is not used, the 2025 booklet governs; Schedule 3 line 1 (PDF page 24: joint 2,000, all other filers 1,000); Form IT-40 lines 1-8 (PDF page 1; line 8 'multiply line 7 by 3% (.03)'); booklet PDF page 8 Line 1; PDF pages 5-6 rounding

worked: Federal AGI = wages person 0 50,000.00 + military retirement person 0 36,000.00 = 86,000.00. Federal taxable income = 86,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 70,250.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored; Indiana starts from federal AGI). Form IT-40 line 1 federal AGI 86,000.00. Line 2 add-backs 0.00; line 3 = 86,000.00 + 0.00 = 86,000.00. Schedule 2: line 11 code 632 military retirement 36,000.00; line 12 total = 36,000.00. IT-40 line 4 = 36,000.00. Line 5 = 86,000.00 - 36,000.00 = 50,000.00. Schedule 3: line 1 1,000.00; line 4 0 x 1,000.00 = 0.00; line 5 nobody 65 or older: 0.00; line 7 total = 1,000.00. IT-40 line 6 = 1,000.00. Line 7 = 50,000.00 - 1,000.00 = 49,000.00. Line 8 = 49,000.00 x 0.03 = 1,470.00. No credits; county tax (line 9) is local and out of scope. State income tax 1,470.00. The deduction is the entire military retirement income at any age.
